## Projects

- [Sugbo Now](https://github.com/En1gM-a/SugboNow): Cebu daily intelligence platform with live conditions and an AI daily brief (React, TypeScript, Node.js, Supabase)
- [Kuryentipid](https://kuryentipid.vercel.app): electricity-savings tracker with a bill optimizer and provider rate map (React, Supabase)
- [Planado](https://github.com/En1gM-a/Planado): group planning mobile app with shared calendars and an Android widget (React Native, Expo, Kotlin)
- [MinuteMeeting](https://github.com/En1gM-a/MinuteMeeting): Discord bot that writes AI meeting minutes, with an Electron desktop app (Python, Gemini)
- [Pantawid Pasada](https://github.com/En1gM-a/PantawidPasada): role-based fuel subsidy management system (C#, .NET, MySQL)
- [Clinic Management System](https://github.com/En1gM-a/Clinic-Appointment-Management-System): console clinic appointment system (C#, .NET)
